results.title: Let your children get bored to bolster their creativity: Tip from actress Soha Ali Khan
results.description: Soha Ali Khan champions allowing children boredom for creativity, stepping back from problem-solving for self-reliance, prioritising mental well-being over grades, and viewing home as the first school.
